title: Characteristics and classification of living organisms: topic test
description: A 25-minute test on the whole Characteristics and classification of living organisms topic (Characteristics of living organisms; Concept and uses of classification systems; Features of organisms): 12 questions, 20 marks, from quick recall to an exam-style question. instructions:
Answer every question. You have 25 minutes.
